about: As case 211, but the rename is two runs back. Run run-2026-10-18-1000-migration's b1-u1 sent the rowing line to Ideas/idea-tobias.md for the comment. The writer then renamed that note to Ideas/idea-tobias-rowing.md; the next run, run-2026-10-20-1000-migration, found the rename, carried the copy's handled entry over to the new path, and its history entry holds `renamed`. The rowing line and the comment are still off the handled list. This run's scan finds no rename (`renamed` []). This run's u1, for the same comment, copies the line again into idea-tobias-rowing. `record` follows the earlier unit's copy note through the history entries' renames and refuses: exit 1 naming u1, Ideas/idea-tobias-rowing.md, and the source line. The run stays at migrating.

readings: Run run-2026-10-20-1000-migration's own units aren't part of this case; only its history entry and the carried-over handled entry are.
